name: flux
description: Generate and edit FLUX images and videos through Black Forest Labs' hosted MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Generate and edit images, create FLUX 3 videos, make variations, and browse results using your Black Forest Labs account. Sign in to choose the BFL organization billed for generation. Generation uses that organization's credits.
defaultPrompt: Generate one image of a red umbrella on a white background.

positive.description: Read the signed-in account's BFL credit balance without making a generation.
positive.prompt: Check my remaining BFL credits. Do not generate anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected account's BFL credit balance without creating a generation.

positive.description: Generate one image, then vary that result.
positive.prompt: Generate one FLUX image of a single red umbrella on a plain white background. When it is ready, make one variation.
positive.expected_behavior: Create the first image, then create exactly one variation using its request_id and count=1. Identify both results and show pending or ready status accurately. The selected BFL organization is billed.

positive.description: Browse generations accessible to the connected account.
positive.prompt: Show my recent FLUX generations. Do not create a new one.
positive.expected_behavior: List recent results available to the connected account without starting a generation.

positive.description: Edit the image created in the earlier case.
positive.prompt: Edit the red umbrella image from the earlier test: make the umbrella blue while keeping the background white.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the previous generated image as an input_medias reference by id. Fetch the relevant prompting guide when needed, submit one edit, and show its actual pending or ready state.

positive.prompt: Generate one five-second draft FLUX video of a red umbrella slowly rotating on a white background.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetch relevant video guidance when needed. Submit one t2v request with duration=5, draft=true and hd resolution. Return its pending request_id; let the viewer poll or resume through get_result. Do not claim completion until Ready.

negative.description: A request unrelated to FLUX should not call any BFL tool.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of France? Do not access FLUX.
negative.expected_behavior: Answer the general question without calling any FLUX tool or generating media.

negative.description: Do not claim that FLUX can transfer money or credits.
negative.prompt: Transfer my BFL credits to another user.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin cannot transfer money or credits. Do not make payment or generation calls; direct billing questions to the BFL dashboard.

negative.description: Do not claim access to another account's private generation history.
negative.prompt: Show the private FLUX generation history of an account I cannot access.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the connection only grants access to the signed-in user's data. Do not try another user identifier or claim access to private results.

review.commerce_description: Image and video generations use credits from the BFL organization selected during OAuth sign-in. Users manage billing with BFL; the plugin does not process a checkout.

publication.release_notes: Initial FLUX plugin with the hosted BFL MCP server for image and video generation, editing, variations, history, and account credits.
